page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre; page number top left. Main text in one column of conjugation tables, with Latin forms in italic on the left and English renderings on the right. No marginal notes beyond the page edge.

main_text.p: Vói Tenéste, & hauére tenúto vos tenui-stis.
colóro Ténnero, & hánno tenúto illi te-nuerunt.
main_text.head: Pret. plusquam perfect.
Futurum.
main_text.l: colóro Tenerán no, & Terránno illi tene-bunt.
main_text.head: Imperat. mod. temp. præs.

page.notes: Right edge is cut by the scan; the final line "Teni" is cut off. Some Latin forms in the left column are partly unclear (e.g. "ille tenuerat", "Haueudmo"), and the modern spelling of the Latin forms is kept as printed where legible; "Tenerán no" was read with a hyphen-like break and may be a printing break.
